name: Metagenomic classifiers benchmark
description: A comprehensive benchmarking study and evaluation of metagenomic classifiers, with ensemble approaches to improve classification.
evaluation_method: precision / recall / F1 (often reported per-rank and aggregated), possibly supplemented by accuracy and abundance-estimation error metrics
typical_sota_score: variable (commonly F1 in the ~0.5–0.95 range depending on taxonomic level and dataset)
reputation: Well-regarded within the metagenomics/bioinformatics community as a comprehensive comparative benchmark for taxonomic classifiers, though not a single universal standard.
notes: Caveats include sensitivity to reference database composition and contamination, variable performance across taxonomic ranks, dataset-specific class imbalance, and that this is a non-LLM, domain-specific benchmark.
